mobsfDetails.title: Cleartext HTTP Traffic Allowed
mobsfDetails.description: Cleartext HTTP traffic is permitted (android:usesCleartextTraffic=true) to all endpoints.
mobsfDetails.remediation: Configure a Network Security Config file and enforce HTTPS.

mobsfDetails.title: Hardcoded Cryptographic Secret Key
mobsfDetails.description: Found a hardcoded 128-bit AES key in com.banking.security.CryptoManager.
mobsfDetails.remediation: Migrate encryption key storage to the Android Keystore system.

mobsfDetails.title: Biometric Bypass Vulnerability
mobsfDetails.description: Biometric validation is implemented without crypto object validation. Bypassable via Frida instrumentation.
mobsfDetails.remediation: Implement biometric validation using a Keystore CryptoObject.

mobsfDetails.title: Exported Content Providers
mobsfDetails.description: The content provider 'com.apex.db.DataProvider' is exported without restrictions.
mobsfDetails.remediation: Set android:exported="false" or require custom permissions.

mobsfDetails.title: Insecure Clipboard Copy
mobsfDetails.description: Sensitive authorization tokens are copied to the clipboard where other apps can access them.
mobsfDetails.remediation: Flag clips containing credentials as sensitive content.

mobsfDetails.title: Weak Hash (SHA-1)
mobsfDetails.description: SHA-1 is used for integrity check signatures.

mobsfDetails.title: Obfuscation Disabled
mobsfDetails.description: Release build lacks class and field obfuscation rules.
